headline: Tiny Glitches That Trick AI
source: Goodfellow, I. J., Shlens, J., & Szegedy, C. (2015). Explaining and Harnessing Adversarial Examples. International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR).

caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Did You Know tiny, invisible changes can completely trick even the smartest AI? 🤯

💡 Imagine showing an AI a stop sign; it calls it a speed limit sign. Tiny, invisible 'noise' fools even the smartest AI, highlighting a surprising blind spot.
